Method of Attack: Code injection via unprotected REST-API endpoints allowing modification of email templates with arbitrary data
Sending phishing emails to registered users on compromised sites
Injection of malicious JavaScript into mail templates leading to potential site takeover, adding admin accounts, redirecting visitors to phishing sites, and injecting backdoors
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using WP HTML Mail plugin
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated access to unprotected REST-API endpoints (/themesettings) allowing execution of saveThemeSettings and getThemeSettings functions
